description: The company's product as a user sees it today: every screen the QA Engineer mapped, on each surface (web app, iPhone app, marketing site), and the main flows recorded through them. Call it before recording, generating or uploading any product UI for a video, a teaser or a post: use a real screen when one exists. `query` finds screens and flows by what they show ("reschedule", "empty state", "checkout") or by route; `surface_id` lists one surface's screens; `platform` (web|ios|android|desktop) narrows; `screen_id` reads one screen in full (everything it opens, where it is reached from); `flow` (a flow key) returns that flow and its screens. Each screen has `still` and `full_page` as Studio `media_id`s (attach_media, set_video_shots and posts take them), `fresh` and `changed_note` (stale since a deploy), `opens` (what its buttons and tabs lead to) and `in_flows`. Each flow has its `recording` (a media id and its length) and per step the `screen` and `t` (seconds into the recording), so a shot can be cut from it. With no arguments: the surfaces, how much is mapped, and the flows.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

query.description: what the screen shows, in words, or a route

surface_id.description: one surface (product_map with no arguments lists them)
